description.value: A McDonald's fast food restaurant in Port Alberni on Vancouver Island, serving burgers, breakfast items, and McCafé beverages. The location includes a drive-through and takeaway service, making it a convenient fuelling stop for cyclists passing through town. As one of Port Alberni's few national chain restaurants, it offers a predictable, affordable option for hot food on the highway corridor.
